json_ld.description:
NEW GIFT BUNDLE Our most popular holiday gifts in a set of two. Ideal for tea lovers, our acclaimed Warming Joy Tea Chests features our largest holiday collection of 40 festive pyramid infusers each, wrapped in their holiday best. The Warming Joy Assorted Tea Chest (red) offers a detailed tasting menu under the lid of variety of tea types for everyone, including black, green, white and herbal teas, inviting the discovery of new favorites. The Warming Joy Herbal Tea Chest (green) offers an detailed tasting menu under the lid of 40 herbal teas, 2 of each, nearly all of which are caffeine-free. Our Tea Chests are the most comprehensive offering for the holiday table or gifting to your most treasured tea lover.
The Warming Joy Tea Chest Combo Gift Bundle is a $176 value and includes:

One Warming Joy Assorted Tea Chest of 40 assorted pyramid tea infusers, two of each blend
One Warming Joy Herbal Tea Chest of 40 herbal pyramid tea infusers, two of each blend

Each pyramid infuser steeps 8-12 ounces of tea
Each box measures 8.0L x 8.0D x 3.75H"
Please note: Pyramid infusers are not microwave-safe


All teas in this bundle are Kosher Certified
